title: Motorcycle-taxi riders’ demonstration over alleged security-force extortion and abuse
scope: Reported public demonstration by motorcycle-taxi riders; single site in source.
threshold_50_evidence: Unknown; the article gives no participant count.

occurrence.summary: Radio Dalsan says riders demonstrated at KM4 on July 2; lines 146–158.

demands.summary: Riders objected to alleged extortion, abuse and road-access restrictions and sought government intervention; lines 146–158.

state_response.summary: Source reports police attempted dispersal with live ammunition and force; lines 146–158. Other response dimensions unknown.

notes: No end date; source reports no crowd size. Police response is described as occurring during the protest. No official statement at publication is not coded as ignore.
open_questions: What was the simultaneous attendance at KM4? Is there a separate independent source and an end date?

title: Haramcad troops’ road blockade over unpaid federal salaries
scope: Reported road blockade by armed Somali police troops; whether a qualifying public gathering occurred is unresolved.
threshold_50_evidence: Unknown; source gives no troop or attendee count, and traffic volume is not attendance.

occurrence.summary: Garowe Online describes troops blocking the road to demand overdue federal salaries; lines 10–27.

participants.summary: No troop or public-attendee count. Daily traffic and troop unit membership do not establish participants.

state_response.summary: The troops are the reported actors; their actions are not coded as response by the state to a separate gathering. Other fields unknown.

notes: Do not infer qualifying public gathering from road closure; source reports troop gunfire, not protester violence or response to a distinct gathering.
open_questions: Did members of the public assemble at the site, and how many? Was this a public protest or internal force action?
